title: Trojan Food Pantry (Student Basic Needs)
text:
Trojan Food Pantry (Student Basic Needs, USC). Page published January 20, 2026; last updated July 31, 2026. Schedules are listed by term, not by year.

WHAT IT IS
- A supplemental food resource designed to support students in meeting their basic needs. It is not meant to be a student's main food source.

ELIGIBILITY
- Enrolled at USC during the term you seek support.
- No active dining hall meal plan. Students with 20 or fewer remaining meals may be considered.
- Experiencing food insecurity.
- Eligible students may get a limited amount of groceries per week during posted hours.

INTAKE AND VISITS
- Complete the intake form once per semester (linked from the page as a usc.qualtrics.com form).
- At the first visit each term, show a screenshot of the completed form.
- Bring your physical USCard to every visit; a card swipe system is used.
- Pickup on behalf of friends is not accommodated.
- Bring your own reusable bag to each visit.

LOCATION AND HOURS
- Location: King Hall (KOH), Suite 103, University Park Campus.
- Fall and spring: about 15 weeks, from the first week of classes through Classes End week. Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays, 10:00 AM to 2:00 PM.
- Summer: first week of June through last week of July. Wednesdays only, 11:00 AM to 2:00 PM.

CONTACT
- Email: basicneeds@usc.edu. Instagram: @uscbasicneeds.
- Mailing address: 1025 W 34th Street, King Hall KOH STE 103, Los Angeles, CA 90089.
- No phone number is listed.

RELATED STUDENT BASIC NEEDS SERVICES
- Food support: CalFresh; Emergency Meal Swipe.
- Housing support.
- Economic support (financial assistance; no details on this page).
- Tommy's Closet.
- Resource navigation and partnerships.
- Donations: studentbasicneeds.usc.edu/get-involved/donate/.
